name: Incorrect Date Format for Leave
goal: User provides leave dates in an invalid format.
constraints: Bot should prompt user to re-enter dates in correct format.

phases.description: User says 'Mujhe 10-07-2024 se 12-07-2024 tak sick leave chahiye'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot detects invalid date format and asks for correct format (YYYY-MM-DD).

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
